description: Declaration of a yobel debt-release rite. Yobel (ヨベル) implements collective one-way debt forgiveness per ADR-2605201800. The declared rite is a Council-ratified scoped forgiveness window; subsequent enrollments + release MST events bind to this declaration. Per CLAUDE.md `Schema invariant (Charter Rider §2(b) one-way enforcement)`: the schema STRUCTURALLY excludes any release method that re-asserts debt (liquidation / seizure / margin call). Rite declaration requires Council Lv6+ × 3 ratification + Lv9 chair per the dmn/council-ratification-threshold DMN.

riteType.description: Rite type. Adding new values requires ADR amending this actor + Council Lv9 vote per CLAUDE.md `riteType extension` boundary.

doctrinalBasis.description: Scriptural / doctrinal grounding for the rite (e.g. Leviticus 25 yobel cycle, Deuteronomy 15 shemittah, etzhayyim ADR-2605201800 §religious-basis). PII filter applies.

scope.description: Geographic + jurisdictional + member-class scope of the rite.

councilRatification.description: Council Lv6+ × 3 ratification + Lv9 chair signatures.

intendedUse.description: G5: structurally rejects military / state-mandated / corporate-coercive use (Charter Rider §2(a) + ADR-2605201800 §intended-use).

windowEndsAt.description: End of the rite window. Enrollments + releases cited against this riteId after this timestamp are rejected.

jurisdictionCodes.description: ISO-3166-2 codes (or 'global' for cross-jurisdiction). Per-jurisdiction Council ratification may apply.

maxAggregateReleasedMicroUsdc.description: Hard cap on the total USDC (micro-USDC, USDC × 10^6) that may be released under this rite. Per ADR-2605201800.

lv6PlusSignatures.description: ≥3 Council Lv6+ signatures (per CLAUDE.md `Rite declaration` boundary).

lv9ChairSignature.description: Lv9 chair signature. councilLevel MUST be exactly 9.

dmnGateAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the dmn/council-ratification-threshold.md DMN evaluation trace.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (riteId + riteType + windowStartsAt + windowEndsAt).
